description: This file defines an interface 'IReader' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifying methods and constants for reading spreadsheet files, including configuration options such as whether to read charts, data only, handle empty cells, load specific sheets, and manage external images.

classes.name: IReader
classes.description: Interface for spreadsheet file readers, providing configuration and loading functionalities.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the reader can read the specified file.

methods.name: getReadDataOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the reader is set to read data only.

methods.name: setReadDataOnly
methods.description: Sets the reader to read data only or not.

methods.name: getReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Checks if the reader is configured to read empty cells.

methods.name: setReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Configures whether to read empty cells.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Determines if charts should be included when reading.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Sets whether to include charts during reading.

methods.name: setLoadAllSheets
methods.description: Configures the reader to load all sheets.

methods.name: setAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Configures whether external images are allowed.

methods.name: getAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Checks if external images are allowed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet from a file, with specified flags.
